questions.stem: How are dandelion seeds adapted for wind dispersal?

options.text: They are brightly coloured to attract birds
They explode from the pod when ripe
They have hooks that attach to animal fur
They have light, feathery parachute-like structures

questions.explanation: Dandelion seeds have light, feathery structures that act like parachutes, allowing them to be carried long distances by the wind.
